properties.title: Kaguya GRS Nuclide Map - Uranium
properties.lri:data_use_note: Elemental uranium abundance (ppm) from the Kaguya GRS Nuclide Map at 1° resolution (~30 km). Kaguya GRS provided the first global U/Th ratio map of the Moon; low, spatially variable U/Th elsewhere on the farside is notable relative to KREEP terrane values.
properties.lri:quality_note: Global mean of 0.52 ppm U, of the same order as the global average of approximately 0.3 ppm and maximum of approximately 2 ppm reported by Kobayashi and Yamashita et al. for Kaguya GRS uranium. A number of low-U pixels compute to slightly negative values under the label's scaling formula, a normal artifact of gamma-ray count-rate fitting near the detection floor, also present in Lunar Prospector GRS products; these values are floored to 0.
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.processing:lineage: Raw UInt16 binary (GRS_NMAP_U_071214_081216.img, detached PDS3 label) read via GDAL's PDS driver and converted to U ppm using gdal_calc.py with the label formula raw x 0.001 - 1.0, floored at 0 with numpy.maximum to remove small negative artifacts from background subtraction. Reassigned from the PDS driver's projected CRS (metres) to IAU:30100 (degrees, same sphere and grid) and written as COG via gdal_translate with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
